species.name: Chespin
species.flavor: Such a thick shell of wood covers its head and back that even a direct hit from a truck wouldn’t faze it.

species.name: Quilladin
species.flavor: They strengthen their lower bodies by running into one another. They are very kind and won’t start fights.

species.name: Chesnaught
species.flavor: When it takes a defensive posture with its fists guarding its face, it could withstand a bomb blast.

species.name: Fennekin
species.flavor: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.

species.name: Braixen
species.flavor: When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.

species.name: Delphox
species.flavor: Using psychic power, it generates a fiery vortex of 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit, incinerating foes swept into this whirl of flame.

species.name: Froakie
species.flavor: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

species.name: Frogadier
species.flavor: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute’s time.

species.name: Greninja
species.flavor: It appears and vanishes with a ninja’s grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.

species.name: Bunnelby
species.flavor: It’s very sensitive to danger. The sound of Corviknight’s flapping will have Bunnelby digging a hole to hide underground in moments.

species.name: Diggersby
species.flavor: The fur on its belly retains heat exceptionally well. People used to make heavy winter clothing from fur shed by this Pokémon.

species.name: Fletchling
species.flavor: When this Pokémon gets excited, its body temperature increases sharply. If you touch a Fletchling with bare hands, you might get burned.

species.name: Fletchinder
species.flavor: Fletchinder are exceedingly territorial and aggressive. These Pokémon fight among themselves over feeding grounds.

species.name: Talonflame
species.flavor: Talonflame dives toward prey at speeds of up to 310 mph and assaults them with powerful kicks, giving the prey no chance to escape.

species.name: Scatterbug
species.flavor: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.

species.name: Spewpa
species.flavor: The beaks of bird Pokémon can’t begin to scratch its stalwart body. To defend itself, it spews powder.

species.name: Vivillon
species.flavor: The patterns on this Pokémon’s wings depend on the climate and topography of its habitat. It scatters colorful scales.

species.name: Litleo
species.flavor: This hot-blooded Pokémon is filled with curiosity. When it gets angry or starts fighting, its short mane gets hot.

species.name: Pyroar
species.flavor: The temperature of its breath is over 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, but Pyroar doesn’t use it on its prey. This Pokémon prefers to eat raw meat.

species.name: Flabébé
species.flavor: Flabébé wears a crown made from pollen it’s collected from its flower. The crown has hidden healing properties.

species.name: Floette
species.flavor: It gives its own power to flowers, pouring its heart into caring for them. Floette never forgives anyone who messes up a flower bed.

species.name: Florges
species.flavor: Its life can span several hundred years. It’s said to devote its entire life to protecting gardens.

species.name: Skiddo
species.flavor: If it has sunshine and water, it doesn’t need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back.

species.name: Gogoat
species.flavor: They inhabit mountainous regions. The leader of the herd is decided by a battle of clashing horns.

species.name: Pancham
species.flavor: Wanting to make sure it’s taken seriously, Pancham’s always giving others a glare. But if it’s not focusing, it ends up smiling.

species.name: Pangoro
species.flavor: Using its leaf, Pangoro can predict the moves of its opponents. It strikes with punches that can turn a dump truck into scrap with just one hit.

species.name: Furfrou
species.flavor: Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer, but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.

species.name: Espurr
species.flavor: There’s enough psychic power in Espurr to send a wrestler flying, but because this power can’t be controlled, Espurr finds it troublesome.

species.name: Meowstic
species.flavor: The defensive instinct of the males is strong. It’s when they’re protecting themselves or their partners that they unleash their full power.

species.name: Honedge
species.flavor: The blue eye on the sword’s handguard is the true body of Honedge. With its old cloth, it drains people’s lives away.

species.name: Doublade
species.flavor: The two swords employ a strategy of rapidly alternating between offense and defense to bring down their prey.

species.name: Aegislash
species.flavor: Its potent spectral powers allow it to manipulate others. It once used its powers to force people and Pokémon to build a kingdom to its liking.

species.name: Spritzee
species.flavor: The scent its body gives off enraptures those who smell it. Noble ladies had no shortage of love for Spritzee.

species.name: Aromatisse
species.flavor: The scents Aromatisse can produce range from sweet smells that bolster allies to foul smells that sap an opponent’s will to fight.

species.name: Swirlix
species.flavor: The sweet smell of cotton candy perfumes Swirlix’s fluffy fur. This Pokémon spits out sticky string to tangle up its enemies.

species.name: Slurpuff
species.flavor: Slurpuff’s fur contains a lot of air, making it soft to the touch and lighter than it looks.

species.name: Inkay
species.flavor: By exposing foes to the blinking of its luminescent spots, Inkay demoralizes them, and then it seizes the chance to flee.

species.name: Malamar
species.flavor: It’s said that Malamar’s hypnotic powers played a role in certain history-changing events.

species.name: Binacle
species.flavor: If the two don’t work well together, both their offense and defense fall apart. Without good teamwork, they won’t survive.

species.name: Barbaracle
species.flavor: Having an eye on each palm allows it to keep watch in all directions. In a pinch, its limbs start to act on their own to ensure the enemy’s defeat.

species.name: Skrelp
species.flavor: Skrelp looks like a piece of rotten seaweed, so it can blend in with seaweed drifting on the ocean and avoid being detected by enemies.

species.name: Dragalge
species.flavor: Dragalge generates dragon energy by sticking the plume on its head out above the ocean’s surface and bathing it in sunlight.

species.name: Clauncher
species.flavor: By detonating gas that accumulates in its right claw, this Pokémon launches water like a bullet. This is how Clauncher defeats its enemies.

species.name: Clawitzer
species.flavor: Clawitzer’s right arm is a cannon that launches projectiles made of seawater. Shots from a Clawitzer’s cannon arm can sink a tanker.

species.name: Helioptile
species.flavor: The sun powers this Pokémon’s electricity generation. Interruption of that process stresses Helioptile to the point of weakness.

species.name: Heliolisk
species.flavor: One Heliolisk basking in the sun with its frill outspread is all it would take to produce enough electricity to power a city.

species.name: Tyrunt
species.flavor: This Pokémon is selfish and likes to be pampered. It can also inflict grievous wounds on its Trainer just by playing around.

species.name: Tyrantrum
species.flavor: A single bite of Tyrantrum’s massive jaws will demolish a car. This Pokémon was the king of the ancient world.

species.name: Amaura
species.flavor: Amaura is an ancient Pokémon that has gone extinct. Specimens of this species can sometimes be found frozen in ice.

species.name: Aurorus
species.flavor: When gripped by rage, Aurorus will emanate freezing air, covering everything around it in ice.

species.name: Sylveon
species.flavor: It emits a soothing aura from its ribbon-shaped organs. It wraps these appendages around quarrelers to instantly restore calm to the situation.

species.name: Hawlucha
species.flavor: It always strikes a pose before going for its finishing move. Sometimes opponents take advantage of that time to counterattack.

species.name: Dedenne
species.flavor: Since Dedenne can’t generate much electricity on its own, it steals electricity from outlets or other electric Pokémon.

species.name: Carbink
species.flavor: It’s said that somewhere in the world, there’s a mineral vein housing a large pack of slumbering Carbink. It’s also said that this pack has a queen.

species.name: Goomy
species.flavor: Goomy hides away in the shade of trees, where it's nice and humid. If the slime coating its body dries out, the Pokémon instantly becomes lethargic.

species.name: Sliggoo
species.flavor: A creature given to melancholy. I suspect its metallic shell developed as a result of the mucus on its skin reacting with the iron in Hisui's water.

species.name: Goodra
species.flavor: Able to freely control the hardness of its metallic shell. It loathes solitude and is extremely clingy—it will fume and run riot if those dearest to it ever leave its side.

species.name: Klefki
species.flavor: Klefki sucks in metal ions with the horn topping its head. It seems this Pokémon loves keys so much that its head needed to look like one, too.

species.name: Phantump
species.flavor: With a voice like a human child’s, it cries out to lure adults deep into the forest, getting them lost among the trees.

species.name: Trevenant
species.flavor: Small roots that extend from the tips of this Pokémon’s feet can tie into the trees of the forest and give Trevenant control over them.

species.name: Pumpkaboo
species.flavor: The light that streams out from the holes in the pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people and Pokémon that see it.

species.name: Gourgeist
species.flavor: In the darkness of a new-moon night, Gourgeist will come knocking. Whoever answers the door will be swept off to the afterlife.

species.name: Bergmite
species.flavor: Lives on mountains blanketed in perennial snow. It freezes water vapor in the air to make the ice helmet that it dons for defense.

species.name: Avalugg
species.flavor: The armor of ice covering its lower jaw puts steel to shame and can shatter rocks with ease. This Pokémon barrels along steep mountain paths, cleaving through the deep snow.

species.name: Noibat
species.flavor: No wavelength of sound is beyond Noibat’s ability to produce. The ultrasonic waves it generates can overcome much larger Pokémon.

species.name: Noivern
species.flavor: Flying through the darkness, it weakens enemies with ultrasonic waves that could crush stone. Its fangs finish the fight.

species.name: Xerneas
species.flavor: When the horns on its head shine in seven colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

species.name: Yveltal
species.flavor: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

species.name: Zygarde
species.flavor: Some say it can change to an even more powerful form when battling those who threaten the ecosystem.

species.name: Diancie
species.flavor: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.

species.name: Hoopa
species.flavor: It is said to be able to seize anything it desires with its six rings and six huge arms. With its power sealed, it is transformed into a much smaller form.

species.name: Volcanion
species.flavor: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.
